files.note: LPEC bytes in a .dvf — PRONOM's DVF-TRC regex does not cover this file

container_map.0x0c: codec family: 01 01 00 00 = LPEC-family (MSV sample and budgtele.dvf), 01 02 00 00 = TRC (PVoice.dll files) — matches PRONOM 2023 BOF patterns; NOTE PRONOM ties 01 02 to '.dvf TRC' but extension is not a reliable codec indicator
container_map.0x20: 16-byte origin string: recorder model ('ICD-BM1') or codec DLL ('PVoice.dll', 'STVoice.dll')
container_map.0x30: 4B codec flags (01 01 00 00 on LPEC files, 00 00 00 00 on TRC files)
container_map.0x34: BE date/time block: u16 year, u8 month, u8 day, u8 hour, u8 min — validated against filenames on 2 files; 0xFF = unset (taxis.dvf)
container_map.0x3c: BE u16 codec submode constant: 42 (MSV LPEC) / 44 (STVoice LPEC) / 48 (TRC); followed by 00 01 (PRONOM regex tail)
container_map.0x40: BE u32 bitrate bits/s: 16000 / 19200 / 6000 across the three codec variants seen
container_map.0x44: BE u32 == 0x40 / 8 exactly in all 3 decoded files (2000 / 2400 / 750 bytes-per-second) — first public statement of this relation
container_map.0x50: 8-byte-stride tag/size table: [tag u32 LE][value/size u32 BE-ish], tags seen 01,02,05,06,07,09,0a,0b,03,04,03 — then zero padding; TOC semantics unverified
container_map.audio_start: not yet pinned; WelcometoPinkstonMiddleSchoolLibrarytest.dvf shows a constant-fill block at 1-2KB, audio entropy from ~2KB

codec_region: audio payload entropy 7.7-7.9 bits/byte = compressed bitstream (LPEC/TRC), no structure visible at byte level
re_next_steps: pin audio start offset + frame size from bitrate field (bytes/s predicts exact frame count if fixed-frame)
map the 0x50 tag/size TOC against files with >1 voice memo segment
LPEC is the open prize: no public decoder; candidate route = bitstream statistics on files with known text annotations
